items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: That's when they brought Buddy Rich. I said, the only way we can do this, bring put him in the spot... We had a -- we split things... Buddy BONGO would play something, four bars; you answer.

ctx.x: And I organized the band in '41. He was around with a little band -- he had a little band that played with the Sibonnet orchestra, and then he went to the G with the Buddy , was another club there, had a little six, seven piece band, nothing, amount to nothing, you know. So Latin music begin to develop.
